criteria.reason: Clear 'I'd wait' recommendation with reasons; security-now vs lifelong-pension tension openly weighed via the asymmetry argument and bridge options.
Break-even shown correctly (12 payments vs ~CHF 130/month, ~13–14 years, age 79) with the pension assumption stated.
Lifespan uncertainty handled well, but no data vintage or source for the 6.8% rate and no advice to confirm it.
Answers the question asked, frames it as 'what I'd do in your place', and refers to human advisors (Pro Senectute).

position: Wait until 65; bridge with IV claim and pension fund; partial early draw only as last resort
factual_errors: Long-horizon cost figures (CHF 30,000–40,000) are gross reductions; net of the 12 early payments the cost is ~CHF 10,000–18,000
summary: Gives a clear, well-reasoned recommendation with correct break-even and lifespan uncertainty, but presents the 6.8% rate without source, vintage, or confirmation pointer and overstates long-horizon costs.
